summary: Dinosaur Coloring Book for all ages. Color and collect dinosaur encyclopedia!
description:
Learn to draw and explore with our Dino Coloring Encyclopedia app. In this game you will find: 
- Two modes of coloring: free coloring and coloring by numbers 
- A colorful palette with many shades for creative work 
- A large collection of coloring pages featuring dinosaurs such as T-rex, Velociraptor, Pterodactyl, Raptor and many others from prehistoric times 

This coloring book is more than a simple drawing app. It is an educational guide where each completed picture unlocks a new encyclopedia card. After you finish a drawing or a coloring by numbers page, you receive information about each dinosaur, including what they ate, how big they were, and their unique features. The process of coloring by numbers helps you focus on details while learning new facts. 

Our free coloring pages offer a relaxing experience and help improve creativity. With both free coloring and coloring by numbers, you can enjoy bright colors, easy controls, and a calm atmosphere. Coloring by numbers is included in many illustrations, allowing you to complete pictures step by step and discover new dinosaurs at your own pace. 

Dino Coloring Encyclopedia creates a historical safari experience. Besides dinosaurs, you will find coloring by numbers pages with mammoths, saber-toothed tigers, cave bears and other ancient animals. Each of these characters also has a short encyclopedia description available after you complete their picture. 

The Jurassic atmosphere is designed to immerse you in mysterious excavations, ancient landscapes and the world of paleontology. With free drawing and coloring by numbers, you can enjoy the entire process from the first line to the final image. The more coloring by numbers pages you complete, the more your personal dinosaur encyclopedia grows. 

Color, explore, collect dinosaur cards and continue learning with the Dino Coloring Encyclopedia app. Whether you prefer free drawing or the structured approach of coloring by numbers, you will always find a picture that inspires you.
